name: diagrams: a block shown inside a longer fence is an example, not a diagram
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/blocks.test.mts -t "do not include a mermaid block that is shown inside a longer fence"

name: diagrams: a fence the file ends inside is not called closed
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/blocks.test.mts -t "say so when the file ends before the fence does"

name: diagrams: a path that is not there is refused, not skipped
find: throw new CouldNotRun(`${path} does not exist`);
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/blocks.test.mts -t "refuse a path that is not there"

name: diagrams: nothing to render fetches nothing and starts no browser
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-diagrams.test.mts -t "is a skip, not a pass, and never asks for the renderer"

name: diagrams: nothing to render is a skip, not a pass
find: ...(diagrams === 0 ? { skipped: files.length === 0 ? "no markdown file" : `no mermaid diagram in ${files.length} markdown file(s)` } : {}),
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-diagrams.test.mts -t "says when there was no markdown file at all"

name: diagrams: the line named is a line of the file
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-diagrams.test.mts -t "names the line of the file, not the line of the diagram"

name: diagrams: a fence that is never closed is not handed to the renderer
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-diagrams.test.mts -t "is a finding, and is not handed to the renderer"

name: cited paths: a line citation is not part of the path
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-cited-paths.test.mts -t "is read without a line citation"

name: cited paths: only a span that starts at the top of the repository is a path
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-cited-paths.test.mts -t "is not a route, a dot-file, a placeholder"

name: cited paths: what a code block shows is an example
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-cited-paths.test.mts -t "passes, counts every citation, and finds the repository from the document"

name: cited paths: an exception excuses the path it names and no other
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-cited-paths.test.mts -t "is still a finding when only another path is excepted"

name: cited paths: nothing cited is a skip, not a pass
find: ...(cited === 0 ? { skipped: files.length === 0 ? "no markdown file" : `no repository path is cited in ${files.length} markdown file(s)` } : {}),
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-cited-paths.test.mts -t "is a skip, not a pass"

name: site: a heading's anchor is GitHub's, not the simple rule
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/page.test.mts -t "gets the anchor GitHub gives it"

name: site: a link to a document leads to its page
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/page.test.mts -t "to another document of the set leads to its page"

name: site: a link is written from where the page is
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/page.test.mts -t "is written from where the page is, not from the top"

name: site: only a mermaid block becomes a figure
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/page.test.mts -t "is the only kind of block that does"

name: site: a page in a folder reaches the top of the copy
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/page.test.mts -t "reaches the top of the copy from a page in a folder"

name: site: the copy is never written into the documents' own folder
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/build-site.test.mts -t "refuses to write into the documents' own folder"

name: site: two documents never become one page
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/build-site.test.mts -t "refuses two documents that would become one page"

name: site: what was built before does not stay
find:
rmSync(destination, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(destination, { recursive: true });
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/build-site.test.mts -t "replaces what was there"

name: site: a link that leaves the set points at a web address when one is given
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/build-site.test.mts -t "point a link that leaves the set at a web address when one is given"

name: tools: no package's install script is run
find: const installed = run("npm", ["ci", "--ignore-scripts", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], { cwd: partial, env });
replace: const installed = run("npm", ["ci", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], { cwd: partial, env });
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "installs from the lockfile, runs no package's script"

name: tools: a failed fetch leaves no folder that looks finished
find:
if (installed.error !== undefined || installed.status !== 0) {
    rmSync(partial, { recursive: true, force: true });
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "leaves no folder that looks finished when the fetch fails"

name: tools: tools already fetched are not fetched again
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "fetches nothing the second time"

name: tools: the headless-only build is used before the whole browser
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "is the headless-only build before the whole browser"

name: tools: a browser a person named is the only one tried
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "is the one a person named, and nothing else when that one is not there"

name: tools: the browser keeps its sandbox outside CI
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/tools.test.mts -t "keeps its sandbox, except as root and in CI"

name: render: a diagram Mermaid cannot read is an error, never a drawn bomb
test: pnpm vitest run scripts/architecture-docs/check-diagrams.test.mts -t "is asked for in a way that makes a diagram Mermaid cannot read an error"
